# Pricing — OpenMarkdown

> OpenMarkdown is free, local, and account-free. If you want to help build what's next, you can back it — a one-time supporter tier, no subscription.

forever, no account

- The whole app — nothing held back
- No account, no tracking, no strings

### Where the money goes

- Apple developer account — signing and notarizing the macOS app
- The openmarkdown.dev domain
- Download mirror servers, so the app downloads fast where GitHub is slow
- Whatever's left goes into building what's next

### Other ways to help — free

- [Upvote or review us on Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/products/openmarkdown)
- [Star us on GitHub](https://github.com/OpenMarkdown-dev/OpenMarkdown-releases)
- Tell a friend who lives in Markdown
- [Send us bugs and ideas](https://openmarkdown.dev/feedback)

The app stays free, local, and account-free. Backing is a **one-time** payment — not a subscription — handled by Stripe, and it adds **no account and no tracking to the app itself**.
